Admission binds a seat to one motor carrier authority. The applicant files an MC number, a USDOT number and a tractor VIN; the node reads the federal register each month for active status, then pulls the electronic logging feed and requires 2,000 loaded miles in the quarter. One authority, one tractor.

Fifty clones need fifty tractors: 85,000 a unit, 4,000 cover, 300 filing, 4.5 million before any payload moves. A dormant authority lapses in a quarter. A violet cab at an inlet dock earns nothing on its ripple of unfiled papers, and a hauler is proved by miles run.
